context:
Goal: sessions actually use the mailbox, so every message has a stored copy that is read.
Problem (rule): the mailbox has no default until the Mac and Windows check runs, so every session still uses send_message, which leaves no copy; that breaks your Nov 10 09:33 CST ruling that every message goes through the git mailbox.
Based on (read): decision session-messages (how sessions message each other): "MAILBOX_REPO (the setting that names the mailbox repo) has no settings.json default until step 2 measures Mac and Windows auth. The default needs the owner's typed words."
Based on (measured): your Windows test, Nov 11 11:57 to 12:24 CST: cloud to Windows worked 5 of 5; Windows to cloud delivered 0 of 5, lost silently. The fix merged in batch 88 (23:50 CST Nov 11). You proved it at about 11:42 CST today: after a reinstall your Windows session took the 5 stuck messages and sent one, stored 1 of 1. A cloud session replied and your Windows helper read it at 11:52 CST, so the Windows round trip has passed. Still to run: the Mac check. Cloud sessions can push to the mailbox repo (access check 11:35 CST today).
Departs from: no session on main has a mailbox default — cloud sessions get one now (a), and your computers get theirs after a re-run (b).
Meanwhile: the mailbox follow-up lane (session-mailbox-followups) runs; nothing else waits on this. Pick either or both.

lastAnswer.note: windows as well now that windows works -- we're just waiting on mac i believe

options.gain: Most sessions get stored messages now.
options.how: Cloud installs set the mailbox repo setting, and cloud sessions move to the mailbox; your computers wait for b.
options.label: Cloud default now
options.lose: Two routes for a while, for messages to or from your computers.

options.gain: Your Mac joins the mailbox too, on a proven route.
options.how: A Mac session runs its check when you are next at it; Windows has already passed both ways (11:52 CST).
options.label: Mac check next
options.lose: A Mac session later, on your time.

ref: decision session-messages; step mail-send-no-file; lane session-mailbox-followups
reply: Recorded 12:00 CST: the mailbox default goes on for cloud and Windows now; only the Mac check is left, and the Mac default follows it. Filed for decision session-messages and the mailbox follow-up lane.
title: How should sessions start using the git mailbox, so every message keeps a stored copy?
why: Recommended: both. a starts stored messages now in the cloud; b brings your computers onto the same route once proven.
